The REST module reaches `AdministrationService.getGlobalProperty` in about a dozen places, all from the `openmrs-module-webservices.rest` repo. I checked each call site by reading the code or the grep output. The `RequestContext` lines (36, 140-141) come from grep only, not a full read.

**Confirmed callers (direct use of the service method)**

1. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RestUtil.java:71-79` is the private wrapper `getGlobalProperty(String, String)`. It calls `Context.getAdministrationService().getGlobalProperty(propertyName, defaultValue)` at line 74, inside a proxy privilege. Every limit and config lookup in `RestUtil` goes through this wrapper, so it is the main choke point.
2. `RestUtil.java:87-101` (`getDefaultLimit`) and `RestUtil.java:109-123` (`getAbsoluteLimit`) depend on the wrapper. They parse the result as an integer and fall back to `RestConstants` defaults when the value is empty or invalid.
3. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RequestContext.java:36` and `:140-141` consume those limits. The field initialiser uses the default limit, and the absolute limit is enforced by throwing an `APIException`.
4. `RestUtil.java:226` reads the allowed-IPs property with a fallback to the existing value.
5. `RestUtil.java:614` sets `RestConstants.URI_PREFIX` from a global property, with a null default.
6. `RestUtil.java:846` reads the stack-trace-details flag with a default of `"false"`.
7. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/helper/LayoutTemplateProvider.java:82-87` reads the layout defaults property. The value is passed to `populateElementDefaults`, which handles null.
8. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/docs/swagger/SwaggerSpecificationCreator.java:173-175` (`toggleLogs`) calls `.equals("true")` directly on the result. A null return would throw a NullPointerException here, so this is the most fragile caller.
9. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/VisitConfigurationController2_0.java:57-66` (`getCurrentConfiguration`) reads the visit assignment handler. `:102-106` (`getEnableVisitsValue`) reads the enable-visits flag with a default of `"true"`. `:140-142` (`getVisitTypesToAutoCloseValue`) reads the auto-close types and checks `isNotBlank`.
10. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/LocaleAndThemeConfigurationController2_0.java:35-38` returns the default theme and locale from the `/localeandthemeconfiguration` endpoint.

**Tests (likely affected if the behaviour changes)**

11. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/ObsResource1_9Test.java:63-68` parses the value with `Integer.parseInt`.
12. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/NameTemplateController2_0Test.java:63` saves and restores the name-template property.

**Core declarations that define the changed behaviour**

13. `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/AdministrationService.java:113-114` and `:133-134` are the two interface overloads, with `@PreAuthorize` on each.
14. `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/AdministrationServiceImpl.java:182` and `:242` are the implementations. I did not read them, so I have not checked the null and default semantics.

**Not checked**

- The TypeScript consumers of the `/localeandthemeconfiguration` and visit-configuration endpoints. I did not search `openmrs-esm-*` repos for them, so they are unverified.
- Dynamic or reflective lookups of these property names. I did not search for them.
- Other repos that call the REST module's `RestUtil` helpers. I only searched `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`.
- The `RestConstants` property-name constants and the `OpenmrsConstants` values, which I did not read.
